data.gender_notes: Almund is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Almund is derived from the Old German word 'alah' meaning 'all' and 'mund' meaning 'protection' or 'ruler'. This name was often given to children who were considered to be a guardian or protector, reflecting the idea of God's protection and care. The name Almund carries the meaning “Ruler, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Almund usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Αλμουνδ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλμουνδ σημαίνει φύλαξ πιστός ή ισχυρός προστάτης. Η ετυμολογία του συνδέεται με τις ρίζες της προστασίας και της πίστης, στοιχεία σημαντικά στη θεολογία και την πνευματικότητα της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Almundus
